brief: Adopt most useful Hotel Vagmi elements in an Augusto-specific premium hospitality UI; retain truthful booking semantics and existing accessible foundations.

currentAugustoObservations.issue: The existing homepage opens with city photography and a very large abstract headline; the hotel is a small inset.
currentAugustoObservations.impact: Guests can read the experience as a destination or lifestyle brand before they understand the hotel.
currentAugustoObservations.recommendation: Make property photography, Hotel Augusto, Godowlia and a useful stay enquiry bar the opening hierarchy.

currentAugustoObservations.issue: Room pages offer separate links to contact, but dates and party are only entered at the final contact form.
currentAugustoObservations.impact: Browsing and booking are separate tasks; guests cannot carry an initial stay choice through the room journey.
currentAugustoObservations.recommendation: Introduce a small shared validated stay-query adapter for arrival, departure, adults, children and room slug. Preserve these across room and contact links.

currentAugustoObservations.issue: The three room stories repeat identical amenities but the decisive bed arrangements are separated by long scrolling.
currentAugustoObservations.impact: Room comparison requires memory and can look more editorial than useful.
currentAugustoObservations.recommendation: Add an explicit compare anchor and a compact comparison surface where all three arrangements are visible, with shared comforts once and direct selection.

currentAugustoObservations.issue: Detail photographs are static decorative panels; the fuller gallery lives elsewhere.
currentAugustoObservations.impact: Guests cannot inspect the most decision-relevant images without leaving the room.
currentAugustoObservations.recommendation: Add a room photo walkthrough with a large contained view, clear image count, caption, previous/next controls and accessible full-size dialog.

currentAugustoObservations.issue: Family alternate image is described as another view of the Family Room although its layout differs.
currentAugustoObservations.impact: A sequence could falsely imply one continuous physical room.
currentAugustoObservations.recommendation: Use captions that explicitly say alternate layout, and label shared bathroom/tea photographs as hotel details.

currentAugustoObservations.issue: The booking form already validates dates, focuses errors, creates an encoded WhatsApp draft and invalidates it on changes.
currentAugustoObservations.impact: This is a strong tested foundation.
currentAugustoObservations.recommendation: Retain those behaviors while making the stay summary, selected room and handoff clearer. Do not replace it with decorative availability UI.

priorityFeatures.name: Stay bar with real handoff
priorityFeatures.vagmiEquivalent: Hero/panel BookingBar carries dates, party and selected room into the booking channel.
priorityFeatures.augustoBehavior: Arrival, departure, adults and children lead to the enquiry with all details retained. CTA should read 'Plan your stay' or 'Enquire for these dates'; a small line explains that the hotel confirms availability.
priorityFeatures.technicalBoundary: A pure parser validates whitelisted query keys and valid calendar dates. Do not put guest names or notes into query strings. Reuse the existing validation/buildWhatsAppUrl adapter.
acceptance: Date/party values remain exact on contact and selected room detail.
Past, invalid, same-day departure and reversed dates cannot prepare a draft.
Query tampering produces safe defaults or visible validation, not unverified room names.
No availability request, inventory or rate is simulated.
Form still works with touch, keyboard and browser-native date entry.

priorityFeatures.name: Room comparison and choice
priorityFeatures.vagmiEquivalent: Room spreads combine genuine photos, bed facts, amenity chips and explicit room links.
priorityFeatures.augustoBehavior: A visible compare section shows Deluxe: double bed; Deluxe Twin: two single beds; Family: two beds. Common air conditioning, private bathroom, TV and Wi-Fi are stated once. A choose link sets the exact room preference and retains dates.
priorityFeatures.technicalBoundary: Use semantic comparison markup on desktop and reflow to labeled room summaries on mobile. Do not hide all options behind a horizontal carousel or modal.
acceptance: All three arrangements readable at 390px without horizontal page overflow.
Each selection resolves to its own room route or preselected enquiry.
No capacity, dimensions, floor plan, balcony or rate inferred from a photograph.
If users ask for advice, let them submit party details for hotel confirmation rather than algorithmically guaranteeing a fit.

priorityFeatures.name: Room photography walkthrough
priorityFeatures.vagmiEquivalent: Main and detail photography make each room tangible.
priorityFeatures.augustoBehavior: A dominant genuine room image with thumbnail or previous/next selection, a visible '1 of 3' count and accurate captions. Open an accessible larger viewer on demand. Manual interaction controls the sequence.
priorityFeatures.technicalBoundary: Use current roomImages and caption mappings; preserve native dialog Escape, focus restoration and keyboard arrows. Avoid auto-advancing the hero or making a guessed continuous virtual tour.
acceptance: All images decode and have truthful alternative text.
Alternate layouts are explicitly identified.
Reduced motion removes displacement while preserving controls.
The selected image and caption remain in sync.
Dialog focus is contained and returned to the opener after closing.

priorityFeatures.name: Room-specific enquiry panel
priorityFeatures.vagmiEquivalent: RoomPageBody includes booking, amenities, policies, call fallback and other-room discovery.
priorityFeatures.augustoBehavior: Place a clear selected-room summary, bed arrangement, dates action and WhatsApp/call route near the practical facts. A desktop sticky panel may stay within its section; mobile uses an inline panel or one concise bottom CTA.
priorityFeatures.technicalBoundary: Any sticky panel must stop before the footer and avoid obscuring focus, gallery controls or date fields. Unknown rates and policies are requests for hotel confirmation, not empty pricing cards.
acceptance: No duplicate sticky/floating CTAs compete on mobile.
Selected room appears in the final WhatsApp draft.
Call link uses the centralized hotel contact.
Facts remain visible without animation or JavaScript.

priorityFeatures.name: Arrival and neighbourhood tools
priorityFeatures.vagmiEquivalent: Location and city guides connect the hotel to real travel needs.
priorityFeatures.augustoBehavior: Use the real exterior, complete address, directions link and a call-ahead note for Godowlia approach/drop-off. Destination cards explain walking-distance context without invented minutes or services.
priorityFeatures.technicalBoundary: Google Maps link remains a user action. No speculative transit ETA, live route or parking guarantee.
acceptance: Hotel and destination photos are unmistakably distinguished.
Directions resolve to the centralized property address.
Relevant arrival questions can be included in the enquiry notes.
No claim of hotel-operated tours or guaranteed temple access.

doNotTransferWithoutEvidence: Vagmi live STAAH rates, discounted price badges, 'best direct rate' promises and tonight deals.
Vagmi room capacity algorithms, automatic room allocation and verified room sizes.
Vagmi meal plans, EP/CP/MAP rates, reply-within-hour promise and booking policies.
Shree Ganesha Palace's 1916 heritage, family history, named cafe, tour arrangements and review metrics.
Decorative testimonials, random review numbers, fake booking activity or scarcity.

motionArchitecture.purpose: Reveal the place and support selection rather than decorate every section.
motionArchitecture.hero: A single deliberate image reveal and headline entrance, with the enquiry bar readable promptly. Never gate entry behind a loading animation.
motionArchitecture.roomSpreads: Photo reveal followed by supporting detail and copy, staggered once. Keep a static readable baseline and use the existing hydration-safe motion preference hook.
motionArchitecture.photoWalkthrough: Short manual crossfade, no auto-advance; reduce to immediate changes under reduced motion.
motionArchitecture.comparison: Clear hover/focus emphasis and selected-state feedback, no moving columns or shifting control positions.
motionArchitecture.nativeScroll: Do not intercept wheel/touch scrolling or add scroll smoothing that changes keyboard behavior.

implementationSequencing: Agree the shared visual tokens and booking-query contract.
Implement property-led hero and stay bar.
Implement room index comparison and stronger photographic spreads.
Implement room detail walkthrough and selected-room enquiry panel.
Wire stay values into existing contact draft validation.
Verify the full journey, accessible dialogs, mobile layouts and reduced motion using the existing QA baseline.
status: Recommendations only; no application or sibling project source changed.
